comment: Mapped kinase and transcription factor species to their canonical protein identifiers (ATM, ATR, TP53, CHEK1/CHEK2, TOPBP1, HDAC4, NFE2L2/NRF2, KEAP1, CDKN1A/p21, BAX, BBC3/PUMA, SET/I2PP2A, PP2A) because model context denotes their active/inactive/proteolysed states. Drug and small-molecule modulators annotated as chemicals (Omaveloxolone, spermidine). DNA_damage and autophagy activity states represent process-level or abstract species, so labeled 'unknown'. The PP2A–I2PP2A species is a physical complex and is represented with its two protein components (PP2A and SET/I2PP2A). Where specific isoforms were not specified, commonly used gene/protein symbols were provided (e.g., PPP2CA for PP2A catalytic activity, CSNK2A1 for CK2 catalytic subunit). Names are up to three likely synonyms ranked by common usage.
